correctness.rationale: The incidence relation i-j in {0,1,3} modulo 7 realizes the Fano plane with 14 vertices and 21 edges; Ind_2 faces are exactly masks with selected degree <=1, so all 2^14-1 masks are decidable. Independently rebuilt all 2256 nonempty faces, f-vector (14,91,322,651,728,392,58), 1121 distinct vertex-toggle face/coface pairs and 10150 nonempty Hasse incidences. A complete topological sort of the resulting directed Hasse graph is acyclic, leaving one critical vertex and thirteen 5-faces; Forman gives precisely a wedge of thirteen S^5 over Z, not merely mod-two Betti ranks. All 7! point permutations exhaust the 168 Fano collineations; composition with the polarity p_i<->l_{-i} gives all 336 automorphisms because every graph automorphism preserves or exchanges the unique bipartition. Signed simplicial Lefschetz traces for every g equal its count of fixed graph vertices minus 1. By rational finite-group semisimplicity, the top homology QG-module equals the augmentation kernel of the 14-vertex permutation module. Full-group vertex transitivity and the two point/line orbits of G+ yield the rational orbit-space invariant dimensions 0 and 1 by barycentric subdivision and rational coinvariants. The script is exhaustive for this single finite graph; no general graph theorem is inferred.
residual_risks: This is a rational equivariant character, not an integral equivariant lattice isomorphism.
Rationally acyclic full quotient need not be contractible or integrally acyclic.

originality.rationale: The computed complex is Ind_2(H), not the published ordinary Ind_1(H), the matching complex on H-edges, or the complex on perfect matchings. General higher independence results cover complete multipartite, paths, cycles, trees and chordal constructions, but the Fano incidence graph is nonchordal, cubic, bipartite of girth 6 and not in the named special classes. No inspected primary result gives the 13 S^5 homotopy plus all-336-group augmentation character. Bounded best-of-knowledge originality with single-graph finite classification motivation.
residual_risks: Graph-specific tables or unindexed incidence-geometry formulations not found in the bounded search may duplicate this fact.

value.rationale: Ind_2 of the Heawood incidence graph is a natural first higher-independence invariant of a canonical finite symmetric design. The result supplies an exact integral homotopy type and identifies the full nontrivial rational 336-element automorphism action and quotient invariant subspaces, which are not read off from face counts or earlier ordinary graph complexes. A fully exhaustive single-object classification is mathematically meaningful here without an infinite-family theorem.
residual_risks: No integral automorphism lattice or quotient integral homology computed; future work should not conflate these with the rational result.
